phrases.usage: Said before eating, drinking, starting any task

phrases.translation: All praise is due to Allah
phrases.usage: Said to express gratitude, after sneezing, after eating

phrases.translation: Glory be to Allah / How perfect is Allah
phrases.usage: Said to express awe or amazement at Allah's creation
Said throughout prayer, and to express that Allah is greater than everything
Said when speaking about future plans or intentions (Quran 18:23-24)
Said to express appreciation or admiration without envy
The Islamic greeting — say it to every Muslim you meet
The response to the Islamic greeting

phrases.translation: May Allah reward you with goodness
phrases.usage: Said to thank someone — the Islamic way of saying 'thank you'
Said when seeking repentance or after making a mistake

phrases.translation: There is no god but Allah
phrases.usage: The most powerful statement of Tawhid (monotheism) — say it abundantly

phrases.translation: May Allah's peace and blessings be upon him
phrases.usage: Said after mentioning the Prophet Muhammad's name — this is a sign of love and respect

phrases.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
phrases.translation: Indeed, we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return
phrases.usage: Said upon hearing news of someone's death or any calamity (Quran 2:156)
